responsibility: Implements several general-purpose Rust builtin macro handlers that do not fit the include or location groups. This file expands compile_error! into an emitted diagnostic, concat! into a synthesized string literal while supporting eager nested macro handling, env! into a compile-time environment lookup with optional custom error text, cfg! into a boolean literal by evaluating parsed meta-item predicates against Session configuration, and stringify! into a string built from the invocation token stream.
